title: Warm Silky French Shrimp Tarte Tatin
description: This Alsatian-inspired dish combines the pungency of dried shrimp with the silkiness of emulsified egg yolks, perfect for a brunch gathering. Made with a FODMAP-friendly crust and a delicate filling, this tarte tatin is a unique twist on the classic French dessert.
instructions: In a food processor, combine the flour, cold butter, and salt. Process until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Add the granulated sugar and pulse until just combined.
Press the mixture into a 9-inch (23cm) tart pan with a removable bottom.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and heavy cream.
Add the lemon juice and whisk until smooth.
Add the dried shrimp and whisk until well combined.
Pour the filling into the prepared tart crust and smooth the top.
Brush the edges of the crust with butter.
Bake the tarte tatin for 40-45 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is set.
Remove the tarte tatin from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Invert the tarte tatin onto a serving plate and serve warm.
Garnish with fresh thyme, if desired.
